arabic text: 'AYE KERBALA HUSSEIN KE GHAM KO NA BHULAANA'
english translation text: PLEASE RECITE A SURAH FATEHA FOR THE MARHUMEEN OF ALL WHO MADE THIS TRANSLATION POSSIBLE

arabic text: AYE KERBALA HUSSEIN KE GHAM KO NA BHULAANA\n(WARNA TUJHE BHI SARAA)\nBHULAA DEGA ZAMANAA
english translation text: O KARBALA DON'T EVER FORGET\nHUSSAIN'S SORROW ELSE, YOU TOO WILL\nBE FORGOTTEN WITH THE WORLD

arabic text: INN RAIT KE URTE HUWE ZARRAAT SE KEHNA\n(ASGHER KI YEHI QABR HAI) USKO NA MITANAA
english translation text: SAY TO THESE FLYING SAND PARTICLES\nTHIS IS ASGHAR'S GRAVE, DON'T OBSCURE IT

arabic text: KHAYMESE NANGE PAAUN CHALI KIS TARHA ZAINAB\n(YE BAAT ALAMDAAR KO) HARGIZ NA BATANAA
english translation text: HOW DID ZAINAB WALK BARE FEET FROM THE TENT\nDON'T EVER TELL THIS TO THE STANDARD BEARER

arabic text: TUJH KO KYA HAI KERBOBALAA KIS NE MUALLAA\n(YE KHUUN HAI RASUUL KA) ISKO NA CHUPANAA
english translation text: KARBALA, WHO HAS ELEVATED YOUR STATUS\nTHIS IS THE PROPHET'S BLOOD, DON'T EVER CONCEAL IT

arabic text: AY CHAAND SITAARO ALI AKBER KI SHAHADAAT\n(SUGHRAA KO NA RASUUL KE)\nRAUZEPE SUNANAA
english translation text: DON'T CONVEY IT TO SUGHRA\nAT PROPHET'S TOMB O MOON\nAND STARS, ALI AKBAR'S MARTYRDOM

arabic text: NEHRE FURAAT KI YE TARAPTII HUWI MAWJE\n(ABBAS E ALAMDAAR KO) SURAT NA DIKHANAA
english translation text: THESE TREMBLING WAVES OF RIVER EUPHRATES\nDON'T (BE AUDACIOUS) TO SHOW FACE TO ABBAS THE STANDARD BEARER

arabic text: PYAASA HAY TEEN ROZ KA NANHA ALI ASGHER\n(PAANI KE EWAZ TEERSE) ISKO NA SULANAA
english translation text: INFANT ALI ASGHAR IS THIRSTY FOR THREE DAYS\nDON'T PUT HIM TO SLEEP WITH AN ARROW, IN LIEU OF SOME WATER

arabic text: DEKHO TO ZARAA GHOR SE AKBER KO LAAEENO\n(HAMSHAKL HAI RASUUL KA) BARCHI NA LAGANAA
english translation text: LOOK CLOSELY TO AKBAR, O ACCURSED PEOPLE\nHE IS THE PROPHET'S RESEMBLANCE, DON'T POKE SPEARS AT HIM
